no_adcom_quote.quote: Your application for Rapaflo® was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because your product is a member of the class of alpha-1-adrenergic receptor antagonist products, including previously approved products, and your product did not pose unique concerns beyond those applicable to other members of this class.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for Rapaflo (silodosin, NDA 022206). The approval memo states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because the drug is an alpha-1-adrenergic receptor antagonist in an established class and posed no unique concerns, and the administrative checklist records 'No AC meeting.' Because no committee met, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
